verdict.rationale: Canva ships an official MCP server for AI assistants and Connect APIs. Through them an agent can search and retrieve designs and pages, export PNG/JPG images that work as screenshots, and access brand kits and templates. That gives some design context, but the tooling is aimed at generating and editing designs, not handing structured context to a coding agent for implementation. Missing for 10: frame/layer structure retrieval, design variables/tokens, component-to-code mappings, any documented design-to-code workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
